info.title: Evonia Gate API
info.description: Identity, authorization, configuration, accounting, and billing control plane. This document covers both Gate surfaces: the `/api/v1` control plane, and the `/api/auth` protocol surface (sessions, organization membership, and the OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect provider) served by better-auth.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: The tenancy root. Every project, member, and invoice belongs to exactly one organization.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Products inside an organization. Creating one seeds development, staging, and production environments.

tags.name: Service accounts
tags.description: Machine identities bound to one project, and the `gate_sk_…` API keys they authenticate with.

tags.name: RBAC
tags.description: Project roles, role bindings, and `POST /authorize` — the permission system your product asks about its own users. Separate from the control-plane roles that govern access to this API.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Versioned variables and secrets per environment. Secret values stay masked until read with `config:reveal`, and every reveal is audited.

tags.name: Social login
tags.description: Optional organization and project provider credentials and public login discovery.

tags.name: Social accounts
tags.description: User-token APIs for listing, linking, and unlinking shared provider accounts.

tags.name: OIDC
tags.description: OAuth 2.1 clients registered against a project, so your product can sign users in through Gate.

tags.name: Accounting
tags.description: Usage events, deduplicated per project on the caller-supplied `eventId` so retries are safe.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Aggregated active-user counts and paid-invoice revenue for a project.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Stripe connection, plans, checkout sessions, and the entitlements a subject currently holds.

tags.name: Subjects
tags.description: The identity behind a subject id. Deleting one erases the Gate user and everything that cascades from it, while leaving billing and accounting rows intact.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Administrative mutations and secret reveals, newest first, with actor, target, request id, and IP.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Inbound Stripe delivery, with one signed endpoint per environment.

tags.name: Auth / Default
tags.description: Default endpoints that are included with Better Auth by default. These endpoints are not part of any plugin.

tags.name: Auth / Organization
tags.description: Organization and membership management: create, invite, accept, set active, and the dynamic access-control roles.

tags.name: Auth / Oauth-provider
tags.description: The OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect provider: authorize, token, userinfo, introspect, revoke, consent, and client registration.

tags.name: Auth / Jwt
tags.description: The signing key set backing token verification.

delete.summary: Delete the Gate identity behind a subject
delete.description:
Erases the user and everything that cascades from it: sessions, linked social accounts, organization memberships, and OAuth tokens and consents. Role bindings naming the principal are removed too, across every project, because the principal no longer exists.

Billing and accounting rows are deliberately kept. `gate_billing_account`, `gate_subscription`, `gate_invoice_revenue`, and `gate_usage_event` are keyed on the opaque subject id rather than on the identity, and deleting them would corrupt Stripe reconciliation and revenue reporting.

The caller must be acting for a project the subject actually signed into — see the 403 below.
